```yaml
name: Fix Dependabot Security Vulnerabilities

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  fix-vulnerabilities:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: block
          allowed-endpoints: >
            api.github.com:443
            github.com:443
            golang.org:443
            registry.npmjs.org:443
            registry.yarnpkg.com:443

      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install npm dependencies (backend/services/utils/socketio)
        working-directory: backend/services/utils/socketio
        run: |
          npm install
          npm audit fix --force

      - name: Install npm dependencies (frontend)
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm install
          npm audit fix --force

      - name: Update Go Dependencies
        run: |
          cd backend/services/bulkdata/http
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@v0.38.0
          go mod tidy

      - name: Update npm Dependencies (backend/services/utils/socketio)
        working-directory: backend/services/utils/socketio
        run: |
          npm install express@4.22.1
          npm install qs@^6.14.2 body-parser@^1.20.4

      - name: Update npm Dependencies (frontend)
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm install next@15.5.12
          npm install koa@3.0.3
          npm install js-yaml@4.1.1
          npm install eslint@8.57.1 eslint-config-next@15.5.12

      - name: Add npm overrides for transitive vulnerabilities
        working-directory: frontend
        run: |
          npm install
          npm install --save-dev @types/eslint@8.57.1
          npm install --save-dev eslint-plugin-react@7.35.0

      - name: Verify No Vulnerabilities Remain
        run: |
          echo "Checking backend/services/utils/socketio..."
          cd backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm audit --json | jq -r '.metadata.vulnerabilities.total' | xargs -I {} test {} -eq 0 || echo "Vulnerabilities found in socketio"
          
          echo "Checking frontend..."
          cd ../../../../frontend
          npm audit --json | jq -r '.metadata.vulnerabilities.total' | xargs -I {} test {} -eq 0 || echo "Vulnerabilities found in frontend"
          
          echo "Checking Go modules..."
          cd ../backend/services/bulkdata/http
          go list -m all | grep -E "(golang.org/x/crypto|golang.org/x/sys)" | grep -v "go.mod" || echo "Go dependencies updated"

      - name: Commit Changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: fix security vulnerabilities" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push origin HEAD:main || echo "Push failed - likely already up-to-date"
```
